0.0.n: A noun for a raised support or platform used to hold things.

0.1.n: Links 台 to 上, showing which object's top is meant.

0.2.n: Names the upper surface here, rather than a space above it.

0.3.n: Marks the destination where something will be placed.

1.0.n: A noun for a raised support or platform used to hold things.

1.1.n: Links 台 to 上, showing which object's top is meant.

1.2.n: Names the upper surface here, rather than a space above it.

1.3.n: Marks the destination where something will be placed.

2.0.n: An English loanword written in katakana; it names the item being placed.

2.1.n: Marks ディフューザー as the thing being placed.

2.2.n: The polite non-past form of 置く, describing the placement action.

3.0.n: An English loanword written in katakana, normally referring to a device for drying hair.

3.1.n: Replaces を here, adding the hair dryer to the things being placed.

3.2.n: The polite non-past form of 置く, describing the placement action.

0.lit: On the top of the stand,
0.tip: 台の上に marks where something will be placed; the action comes later.

1.lit: On the top of the stand,
1.tip: This repeats the location phrase before continuing with what is placed there.

2.tip: Japanese often leaves out the subject, so there is no explicit word for I here.

3.lit: The hair dryer too, I put.
3.tip: も replaces を to show that the hair dryer is another item being placed.
